result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a faded marked crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. Pedestrian safety is compromised by poor visibility due to parked cars and the lack of active traffic control or high-visibility infrastructure.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection on the right side block the sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crossing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the crosswalk.

result.summary: The street is a designated school zone with sidewalks on both sides, but it lacks basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and lane markings. The roadway pavement is in poor condition with visible potholes, and large street trees may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant potholes and cracking in the roadway surface can cause tripping hazards or vehicle swerving.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite being a school zone, there are no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing points.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large, dense tree on the right sidewalk may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way, which is critical in a school zone.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair potholes and cracks to provide a smooth, safe surface for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past the trees.
